Find the $10$th root of unity highlighted in the diagram above.

feedback.problem: Which of the following diagrams shows all the $10$th roots of unity?
feedback.worked_solution:
Geometrically, the $10$th roots of unity have the following properties:

- all of them lie on the unit circle centered in the origin,

- one of the roots is $1,$ corresponding to the point $(1,0)$ on the complex plane,

- the roots form a regular decagon (regular $10$-sided polygon).
